instruction: Enable tap-to-click for the touchpad in the mouse and touchpad settings.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling tap-to-click for touchpad. The config sets it to false initially, and the task is to set it to true. Evaluator verifies the setting returns 'true' (newline included).

Complete coverage: instruction has one requirement (enable tap-to-click) and evaluator verifies exactly this
Data flow is correct: getter executes command -> returns string output -> metric performs exact match comparison
